conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leveraging high-scoring setups and increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
